objects.name: 3I/ATLAS (C/2025 N1)
objects.about: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS seen by two space telescopes: Canada's NEOSSat (visible light, 15 cm telescope, ~800 km orbit) and NASA's SPHEREx (infrared, 0.75-5 um). NEOSSat followed it from July 2025 to February 2026, through perihelion (29 Oct 2025).
